edit.description: the queue-level forest check, beside the per-entry parse
the parse site that hands the cap in
each refusal and the forest that keeps every rule

summary: the queue read refuses a parent no entry answers, a kind pairing the forest forbids, a step blocked outside its own work entry, and a chain deeper than Chain.maxEntryDepth
acceptance: every rule the section states refuses at the queue read, naming the file, and the depth cap reads from the chain with a default of 4
tests: a parent naming no entry in the queue is refused
a work entry whose parent is a work entry is refused
a group whose parent is a work entry is refused
a step whose parent is a group is refused
a step blockedBy a step of another work entry is refused
a parent chain deeper than maxEntryDepth is refused
a declared maxEntryDepth replaces the default of 4
a forest refusal names the file the offending entry lives in
pins: a forest keeping every rule the section states parses
notes: Cross-entry, so the check cannot live in the per-entry schema: the parent graph is only a graph at the queue read. `Chain.maxEntryDepth` is declared with `Chain.order` (`spec/chain.md`) and consumed only here.
